text:
rafa_pm: Kicking off a short thread to align on recruiting 3 design partners for a Private + Dedicated pilot focused on routing resilience and KMS integration. Goal: validate onboarding flow, infra checklist, and rollback playbook. Need final screening questions + interview owners by Tue.

taylor_se: I'll take two technical screens. Recommend targeting mid-size SaaS apps and one regulated (health or fintech) if possible.

rafa_pm: Incentives idea: $10k platform credit + 12 weeks priority Dedicated access + two onsite engineering sessions (remote ok). Also offer a small co-marketing blurb if they want. Thoughts? :sparkles:

nora_security: For regulated partners we must lock data residency + KMS proof-of-rotation. Legal prefers our "Design Partner" NDA. legal-bot: NDA v2026-02-03 updated -> https://redwood.docs/nda-dp.

jules_ops: Ops constraints: some partners won't allow peering. We should be ready to run via customer-managed VPN or a hosted edge. I'll map which infra options we can support and a rough ETA for each.

anya_research: Proposed acceptance criteria (product-facing):
- Performance: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 220ms for our standard prompt suite (we'll share 12 prompts)
- Reliability: <0.5% fallback failure rate across 8 weeks
- Integration: onboarding time <= 72h of dev effort to reach baseline traffic
- Observability: partner can emit tracing and token-level cost data to our ingest (or provide equivalent telemetry)
- Quality: auto-eval pass rate >= 92% on extraction prompts
These will be used to decide whether to expand pilot.

rafa_pm: Add business acceptance: partner signs a short MOU committing to 8 weeks of active usage and provides a product contact for rollout decisions.

nora_security: Screening Qs (draft):```
1) Which cloud region must data live in?
2) KMS vendor and key rotation policy?
3) Can you run a VPN or allow VPC peering?
4) Do you require signed BAAs / specific compliance artifacts?
5) Expected concurrent sessions and average token length?
6) Who approves go/no-go internally?
```
Add a request for one representative prompt + expected output sample.

taylor_se: Onboarding checklist (dev):
- Provide test API key + KMS test key
- Run quickstart which includes routing exercise and fallback trigger
- Share a smoke prompt set (3 samples)
- Confirm tracing headers and sampling rate
Example trigger curl:```
curl -X POST https://private.redwood.ai/v1/chat/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DP_KEY" \
  -H "x-trace-id: dp-test-123" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-dedicated-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this: Hello world"}],"timeout_ms":1500}'
```
That payload will force routing logic and timeout path.

jules_ops: I'll prepare an infra readiness doc with a table: VPN|Peering|Hosted-edge and per-option steps. Also will capture required firewall rules and a playbook for rollback to hosted instances if Dedicated becomes unhealthy.

anya_research: Eval plan: three buckets -> conversational, structured extraction, and short-step code. I'll produce a 12-prompt canonical set and an automated CI job that runs nightly. We'll require partners to allow those eval runs on their pilot traffic or provide a canned dataset.

rafa_pm: Outreach plan: one short intro email, attach MOU + NDA link, propose 30m tech call, highlight incentives and acceptance criteria. Target list: 3 warm leads from sales + 4 cold outreach from our product pipeline.

nora_security: For regulated partner: we'll add a 1-page security checklist they must complete before we enable Dedicated. Score must be >=80% for onboard.

taylor_se: Timing: SDK + quickstart ready by Fri. I'll post repo link and a short video demo.

rafa_pm: Owners: @taylor_se onboarding code, @jules_ops infra/runbook, @anya_research metrics + prompts, @nora_security security checklist, @rafa_pm outreach. Deadline: shortlist Tue EOD, invites Wed.

jules_ops: Ok — I'll mock the rollback playbook: automatic traffic split to hosted 70/30 if p95 breaches for >10m, full rollback if >30m. Will share knobs (split %, timers) in doc.

anya_research: Success condition to graduate: 2/3 partners hit performance SLOs, integration <=72h, and no critical security blockers. If not met, extend pilot + iterate on SDK/infra.

rafa_pm: Perfect. Please drop confirmations in the spreadsheet and tag the row when you take ownership. Will loop back in Wed sync. Thanks.
